fda.text: PERMANENT VISION LOSS VIGADRONE can cause permanent bilateral concentric visual field constriction, including tunnel vision that can result in disability. summary: Vigabatrin carries the strongest type of United States warning, known as a boxed warning, for permanent vision loss that can narrow eyesight into tunnel vision and potentially cause disability [3][4]. Other recorded warnings for this medicine include an increased risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors, as well as brain scan abnormalities and fluid swelling inside the brain coverings of some infants treated for infantile spasms [4]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than testing on people estimated that the risk scores for liver and heart damage are both in the low band [M].
